project_info.theme: Premium striped polo and packaging display
project_info.color_palette: White, black, gray, dark brown wood, deep green

main_subject.detail: A premium tabletop product styling scene featuring two folded striped polos standing upright beside stacked BADASS gift boxes, staged against a dark vertical slat wall with warm sunlight.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic premium packaging still life, luxury menswear merchandising, clean tabletop styling

items: Left: two stacked white BADASS boxes, one upright and one flat, with subtle 'SLOW FASHION' text and green ribbon detail.
Center Right: two folded striped polos standing upright, one gray-white striped with white collar and one black-white striped with black collar.
Top Right: white BADASS wordmark on the dark slat background.
Bottom Left: small white product code 'POKTK740'.
Background: dark vertical wooden slat wall and dark wood tabletop catching directional sunlight.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm shadow bands, crisp highlights on fabric texture and box edges, upscale boutique product mood

assets.name: folded striped polos
assets.usage: Use to preserve stripe spacing, collar colors, fold angles, and standing presentation.

assets.name: BADASS packaging boxes
assets.usage: Maintain box proportions, BADASS branding, SLOW FASHION text, and green ribbon detail.

assets.name: BADASS / SLOW FASHION / POKTK740 text
assets.usage: Preserve the small visible product code and packaging branding.

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image for exact fold styling, box placement, and stripe pattern fidelity.
Keep visible text exactly where readable, especially 'BADASS', 'SLOW FASHION', and 'POKTK740'.
Preserve the warm sunlight and dark slat backdrop because they define the premium mood.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square premium menswear product still life. Create a dark wood tabletop scene against a dark vertical slat wall with warm directional sunlight. On the left place two stacked white BADASS gift boxes, one upright and one flat, with subtle 'SLOW FASHION' text and a deep green ribbon detail. On the right place two folded striped polos standing upright: one gray-white striped with a white collar and one black-white striped with a black collar. Add a white BADASS wordmark in the upper-right corner and small white product code text 'POKTK740' in the lower-left corner. Technical style: photorealistic premium product still life, directional natural sunlight, crisp fabric texture, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, low resolution, distorted folds, wrong stripe spacing, incorrect branding, cluttered props, flat lighting, watermark, signature, noisy textures
